# Sunlu PETG-CF Model Rocket Print Settings

**MAKE SURE TO DRY YOUR PETG-CF BEFORE PRINTING! IT MAKES A HUGE DIFFERENCE IN QUALITY!**

This bundle makes several changes over the defaults (obviously) including:
- Line Width Tuning
- Seam adjustments (scarf seams, seam position)
- Arachne Wall Generator
- Small area flow compensation
- Reverse on even overhangs (only internal)
- Infill Adjustments
- Small outer wall speed adjustments
- Normal Grid Supports
- Other tunings
name: PETG-CF Class-1 Rocket
